title: discocactus diersianus subsp. cephaliaciculosus
intro: Discocactus diersianus subsp. cephaliaciculosus, commonly known as the 'Pincushion Discocactus,' is a species of cactus in the Discocactus genus. It is known for its unique appearance, with short, fine spines that resemble a pincushion, and is native to Mexico. The Pincushion Discocactus has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids, have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions including antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
